LanguageData.HospitalConditionCuredExternally: {0} no longer needs the operation - the condition has been cured.
LanguageData.HospitalPatientDiedNoPenalty: {0} died. Not your fault, so {1}'s goodwill is unchanged.
LanguageData.BlacklistHint: Checked entries are refused. Patients matching them will not arrive.
LanguageData.BlacklistSurgeriesTooltip: Surgeries that patients will never arrive needing.
LanguageData.BlacklistDiseasesTooltip: Diseases that patients will never arrive with.
LanguageData.BlacklistFactionsTooltip: Factions whose members will never come as patients.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugPoliciesTooltip: Doctors give patients the drugs marked "Scheduled" in the selected policy, as medical bills placed before other bills. Each entry's frequency and mood limits apply. Policies are edited in the drug policy manager.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugListTooltip: The drug policy for this kind of patient. A patient gets the drugs from every list that applies to them.
LanguageData.HospitalDrugTeetotalersTooltip: When enabled, teetotalers also get this list's drugs. When disabled, teetotalers skip this list.
LanguageData.AcceptPatientsTooltip: When enabled, patients from other factions can arrive on this map for treatment.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.AcceptSurgeryTooltip: When enabled, some patients arrive needing surgery.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.AcceptAggressiveTooltip: Challenge. Requires "Allow surgery patients". Some patients arrive needing a cure for a condition that causes aggression, such as scaria. Their faction sedates them for transport. If they are not cured within {0} hours, they wake up berserk. The sedation time is set in the mod settings.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.AcceptDangerTooltip: When enabled, patients arrive even when the map is not safe, for example during a raid or toxic fallout.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.MceAcceptDangerTooltip: When enabled, mass casualty events can happen while enemies such as manhunters are on the map. When disabled, they wait until the map is safe. Dangerous weather is governed by "Allow patients during danger".\n\nDefault: Enabled
LanguageData.SilverMultiplierTooltip: Multiplies the amount patients pay for treatment.\n\nDefault: 100%
LanguageData.GoodwillGainMultiplierTooltip: Multiplies the goodwill gained when satisfied patients leave.\n\nDefault: 100%
LanguageData.DeathGoodwillPenaltyTooltip: Goodwill lost with a patient's faction when the patient dies. By default this applies only to deaths you are responsible for: killed by your colonists, turrets or animals, or dead from illness, blood loss or failed surgery. See "Penalize deaths not caused by me".\n\nDefault: 10
LanguageData.PenalizeNonPlayerDeaths: Penalize deaths not caused by me
LanguageData.PenalizeNonPlayerDeathsTooltip:
When enabled, every patient death costs goodwill. When disabled, deaths caused by raiders, wild or manhunting animals, enemy mechanoids or the environment cost none.

Note: a patient who bleeds out after an animal attack has no recorded killer, so that death still costs goodwill.

Default: Disabled
LanguageData.SurgeryFailGoodwillPenaltyTooltip: Goodwill lost with a patient's faction when surgery on them fails.\n\nDefault: 1
LanguageData.DiseaseSeverityMultiplierTooltip: Multiplies the severity of arriving patients' diseases. Higher is harder.\n\nDefault: 100%
LanguageData.WoundSeverityMultiplierTooltip: Multiplies how badly arriving patients are wounded. Higher is harder.\n\nDefault: 100%
LanguageData.SedationHoursTooltip: How long an aggressive patient stays sedated after arrival. If they are not cured by then, they turn berserk. Used only when "Allow aggressive patients" is enabled in hospital policies.\n\nDefault: 8h
LanguageData.PatientSedatedWarning: Sedated by their faction. They wake up in about {0} hours and will turn berserk unless cured first.
LanguageData.ResetToDefaultsTooltip: Restores all settings on this page to their default values.
LanguageData.ShowMessageAtArrivalTooltip: When enabled, a new patient's arrival is shown as a message instead of a letter.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.ShowPatientBackstoriesTooltip: When enabled, the generated backstory of wounded patients is shown in the arrival letter and in tooltips (Diagnosis column of the Hospital tab, patient chip in the Bio tab).\n\nDefault: Enabled
LanguageData.PreventIncapacitatedArrivalsTooltip: When enabled, arriving patients are wounded only up to the point of collapse, so they can still walk. Disable it for harder mass casualty events with downed patients you must rescue.\n\nDefault: Enabled
LanguageData.EnableLandingSpotVariantsTooltip: When enabled, the larger patient landing pads (3x3 and 5x5) appear in Architect > Misc. They are cosmetic, and patients always land on the center cell. The 1x1 "patients land here" spot is always available, and pads already built keep working.\n\nDefault: Enabled
LanguageData.MassCasualtiesTooltip: When enabled, a mass casualty event occasionally brings a large group of patients at once.\n\nDefault: Disabled
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsHospitalDesc: Whether this bed is for patients.
LanguageData.CommandBedSetAsSurgeryDesc: Whether this bed is for surgery patients.
